'When this hits a hero, if this has {p} greater than its base, they discard a card.' Guardian Action - Attack, so TRIGGERED + ON_HIT (an Action - Attack is never an ATTACK_REACTION). Blue printing of the same card already drafted as .drafts/concuss_red.json - identical text, slug differs only; shape re-verified against the handlers this session.

RELEASE NOTE 1 ('does not trigger if you hit anything other than a hero, i.e. an ally') = ability-level ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate - false when combat.attack_target is set (permanent/ally target), true for hero attacks (condition_types.py:1960-1977).

RELEASE NOTE 2 ('{p} of Concuss is checked on the resolution of the trigger, not when Concuss hits a hero') = ability-level conditions, which the interpreter evaluates at RESOLUTION before effects run; ATTACK_POWER_GT_BASE (condition_types.py:499-509) compares live combat.attack_power against base_attack_power recorded at attack declaration, so pumps applied between hit and resolution are seen, exactly as ruled. It reads no parameters.

RELEASE NOTE 3 ('if they have two or more cards in their hand, they choose which card to discard') = DISCARD's default non-random path: effect_discard asks THE DISCARDING PLAYER which card ('they' = the defender). Handler (effect_types.py:1251-1286) READS amount/player/random/matches; 'they' maps through player DEFENDING -> opponent of the controller. An empty or one-card hand degrades safely (discards what exists / nothing).

No gaps; every clause expressible.
